reason: A more directly tests whether passive-film removal controls synergy by comparing coupled loss against matched wear-only and corrosion-only baselines and predicting degradation above their sum, with sensible repassivation-based boundaries. B is more specific but its chloride-versus-“inert” comparison changes several electrochemical variables without isolating rupture/repassivation, assumes the inert medium permits better film regeneration, and gives an unsupported 20–50% increase.
